Applications

The system, in the real world.

Each format has a default background, a logo version and a short list of rules. When in doubt, start dark, keep Warm White type, and test the contrast.

Presentations

Dark slides, one idea each.

Talk

Reading the sky in plain English

RJMLaird · rjmlaird.co.uk
  • 16:9, Ink background, Warm White titles, Mist body text.
  • Body at 24 pt or larger; titles at 40 pt or larger. Keep to about six lines.
  • Logo: orbit mark in a corner on content slides, full horizontal logo on the title and closing slides.
  • Teal for one emphasis per slide. Never put teal text on a light panel.
  • Describe every image and chart in alt text, and use real slide titles for navigation.

Reports and PDFs

Light pages use Ink.

Report

A short, plain title for the report

  • Warm White or white paper, Ink text (15.9:1 on Warm White), Ink logo.
  • Accents are fills with Ink text only, for example Teal at 8.46:1. Never teal text on paper.
  • Export as tagged PDF with a document title, language, real headings and a sensible reading order.
  • Body at 10–11 pt minimum for print, 12 pt or more for screen reading. Don’t scan pages to images.

Email signature

Text first, logo second.

Ryan Laird

MPhys (Hons) FRAS MInstP CMktr MCIPR

Astrophysicist, science communicator and strategist

rjmlaird.co.uk

  • Emails open on white or in a client’s dark mode, so use the Ink logo and Ink text. Credentials in mono are fine in Ink.
  • Put name, role and links as real text. Never put contact details only inside an image.
  • Links are underlined and spell out where they go: “rjmlaird.co.uk”, not “click here”.
  • Logo PNG at about 120–150 px wide, with alt text “RJM Laird”.

Social

Recognisable at thumbnail size.

  • Profile: the orbit mark on Ink, centred with at least 15% padding so a circle crop doesn’t clip the ring.
  • Banners and cards: Ink background, Warm White headline, one teal accent, horizontal logo.
  • Text lives in the post. Graphics repeat a short headline; the full message and a link go in the caption.
  • Alt text on every image. Describe the content, not “graphic”.

Credentials

Say it plainly, in mono.

MPhys (Hons) FRAS MInstP CMktr MCIPR

  • Post-nominals use JetBrains Mono, weight 600, in Amber on dark (9.4:1 on Ink) or Ink on light.
  • Write them in a fixed order and spell out acronyms on first use in running text.
  • Screen readers read letters one by one: wrap an expansion in the page title or nearby text.

One system for science, space and strategy: clear enough to read, distinctive enough to remember.
